article.headline: Ryan Agarwal scores 17 to help Loyola Chicago turn back San Jose State 72-63
article.description: — Ryan Agarwal scored 17 points to guide Loyola Chicago to a 72-63 victory over San Jose State on Sunday night in the Acrisure Series.
article.linkText: Ryan Agarwal scores 17 to help Loyola Chicago turn back San Jose State 72-63

categories.description: Loyola Chicago Ramblers @ San José State Spartans

event.description: Loyola Chicago Ramblers @ San José State Spartans

keywords: Loyola Chicago Ramblers @ San José State Spartans
article.story: PALM SPRINGS, Calif. -- — Ryan Agarwal scored 17 points to guide Loyola Chicago to a 72-63 victory over San Jose State on Sunday night in the Acrisure Series. Agarwal made 5 of 10 shots with three 3-pointers for the Ramblers (4-2). Guillaume Grotzinger added 11 points and three steals. Chris Jeffrey scored 10 off the bench and went 4 for 4 at the free-throw line in the final 49 seconds to seal it. Joey Chammaa scored 20 and made 11 of 12 free throws for the Spartans (3-3), who went 30 for 41 at the line. Zine Eddine Bedri scored 15 points off the bench and Mekhi Mason added 14 points on 2-for-13 shooting. Agarwal had 13 points in the first half and Loyola Chicago took a 35-31 lead into the break and never trailed after halftime. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
